svg.title: FIG-09 STM32H743ZIT6: finite UART TX DMA and cache Only AXI SRAM selected for initial linker / TX domain; no RX DMA claim
svg.desc: SoC physical-domain facts do not authorize placement; Cortex-M7 CPU Selected D-cache off / on; AXI SRAM: 0x24000000 / 512 KiB Only initial linker and TX payload domain; USART3 TX DMA1 stream0 / DMAMUX request46; ITCM 64 KiB / DTCM 128 KiB Unreachable by DMA1/2; physically reachable by MDMA Not selected by the initial linker; D2 SRAM1/2/3, D3 SRAM4, backup Reachability recorded separately per dma_engines Not selected by the initial linker; Load / store, possibly through cache; DMA reads actual SRAM bytes; Physical CPU path; Physical domain, unauthorized for this TX; Cache-on: exclusive borrow of every complete 32-byte line; Validate AXI domain / overflow / exclusive complete lines 32-byte address alignment; length a multiple of 32, <=65504; Admit -> provider PREPARING marker Borrow already established; cancel cannot reclaim; Clean + barriers under the normal incoming mask No outward rounding or bounce buffer; Recheck cancel / deadline / policy Configure and start DMA only if not terminated; Prove DMA / UART wire / IRQ references drained Only then make final observation and publish SETTLED; Clean / detach failed or incomplete Retain borrow; advance the actual termination path; Admission passed; Long maintenance outside a long IRQ mask; Maintenance complete; Actual completion / drain; Rejection / failure; Drain cannot be proven; Selected DMA TX domain
